title: Bash
description: Execute a shell command. The command is checked against an allowlist first; non-allowlisted commands require explicit user approval. The command runs inside the kernel-enforced sandbox (Landlock / Seatbelt / cgroups). Network egress is blocked by default.

command.description: The shell command to execute. Parsed with shell-quote; no shell interpolation.

cwd.description: Optional working directory. Default: workspace root. Must be inside the workspace.

timeout_ms.description: Optional timeout in milliseconds. Default 30s. Maximum 600s (10 min).

env.description: Optional environment variables to set (merged with the existing env).

stream.description: If true, stream stdout/stderr to the TUI in real-time (line-buffered). Use for long-running commands.
